data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 experienced a significant strengthening of GBP 216.4m in prior year reserves, primarily due to the cost of an external reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction for its 2020 and prior years of account. This RITC, which involved transferring liabilities to Riverstone Syndicate 3500, included a risk premium over reserves being charged, negatively impacting the annual result. The syndicate also faced significant catastrophe events in 2022, including Hurricane Ian, Australian flooding, and the ongoing conflict in Ukraine, which negatively impacted its financial results.

data.data_quality_notes: The sum of the components for gross premium mix (597.2m) does not match the total gross premiums written (605.6m) as presented in the segmental analysis table on page 25. The direct insurance lines show negative gross premiums written, which is unusual and may represent net cancellations exceeding new business. The claims development triangle on page 36 shows zero development for all prior underwriting years, which is explained by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction for 2020 and prior years, transferring these liabilities to another syndicate.
